notes.title: We keep on evolving - 1.0.8 version AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.notes:
So what’s new in this version?

- The Survival mode has been improved. Now, this mode is all about who’s best. To start with, there are now over 99,000 moves. You don’t think that’s enough? 

- New leaderboards for the Survival mode. Show your Evolution Planet Gold Edition friends who really evolves in the rankings. And if you think you’re among the best of this planet, you might as well start showing off now, as you will appear in the global ranking, so don’t be shy!

- Minor fixes and tweaks and overall improvements throughout the game.

IMPORTANT:
The launch of this version means you can participate in the Survival mode competition with a clean slate. But what exactly do we mean by that? It means that, whatever your score was, neither you nor your record will appear in the Hall of Fame. It’s from now on that your Survival mode scores count, so start making history now! 
We are sorry about any inconvenience the launch of the new version may cause you, but hey, if you’re really that good at the Survival mode, stop complaining and amaze us with your record! 

Evolve, you fools!

notes.title: The second update of Evolution Planet Gold, coming out soon!
notes.notes: The update includes plenty of engaging novelties, in the Survival mode and the leaderboards, as well as some minor fixes, tweaks and overall improvements. Stay tuned for more details on the launch of this new version!

notes.title: 1.0.7 version available now!
notes.notes:
What’s new:

-The Survival mode is now ready for you to enjoy… to infinity and beyond!  We have fixed the bug that used to come up in this mode of the game. A special thank you to Maulen for sharing the information with the community and for including screenshots - http://steamcommunity.com/app/495090/discussions/0/358417008722926082/

- The game can now be run on 32-bit Windows, too. 

- The product sheet has been corrected with regard to the availability of Portuguese in the game. While we announced at its launch that the game was available in Portuguese, this has now been corrected, as it is actually Brazilian Portuguese the game has been translated into.
